notes: U.S. plants by state: GM's U.S. Operations page (gm.com/company/us-operations) lists its facilities state by state (59 entries; the page says "50 assembly and parts facilities across 19 states" and "97k+ GM employees in the U.S."), but it publishes no count, employment or investment figure per state, so usStates is null rather than a tally made here; 12 of the listed facilities are recorded as sites. That page is current (fetched Nov 2026, newer than the FY2024 snapshot) and lists the Hudson's Detroit headquarters as opened in 2026; the FY2024 10-K cover address is 300 Renaissance Center, Detroit. The FY2024 10-K Item 2 gives only national totals ("over 100 locations in the U.S." and operations "in 33 countries"; major non-U.S. facilities in Brazil, Canada, China, Mexico and South Korea). Employees come from the 10-K table, filed in thousands: GMNA 123 (includes Cruise), GMI 30, GM Financial 9 (not shown), total 162; U.S. salaried 50 and hourly 47 are separate metrics, not added. GMNA and GMI are GM segments with no country list in the 10-K.
